_about: For every record of data/sources/, the records of data/reproduce/sources.json (spinesurg-ct-nnunet's data platform) that hold its manifest: how it was acquired, from where, the checks on a copy, and how it is fetched again. 'family:B' stands for every manifest record of family B, the anomaly harvest. An empty list means no manifest record exists; the basis says why. tools/reproduce_table.py renders docs/research/datasets-reproduce.md from this file and fails its check when an id here is unknown or a registry record is missing.

aasce.basis: the release and the render bank made from its training films

anomaly_harvest_b.basis: the registry counts 144 sources screened; the manifest's family B is those 144

bern_myelography.basis: the published videos are held among the public clips (PMC8463391, CC BY); request 3 asks for the native DICOM

bournemouth_cervical_qf.basis: the corner tracks are held (Cervical_Database.mat); request 1 asks for the DICOM cine

bournemouth_lumbar_qf.basis: asked for in request 1; nothing held

buu_lspine.basis: the full release, the 2000 relabel, the 400 sample, and the two dead copies the manifest keeps as history

cads.basis: the Hugging Face parts not reachable elsewhere

carmlspine.basis: the release and the render-layout copy of its spot frames

carmlspine_sweeps.basis: the sweeps are case134/ori and case39/CBCT of the release, exported under realxray/carmlspine_sweep

cervical_thoracic_intraop.basis: no public set exists (the registry's reach is NONE); the plan is the project's own captures

cobra_elekta.basis: the Elekta cases of the one COBRA record

cobra_embargoed.basis: the held-back cases of the same record, released 2032-03-01; nothing to fetch until then

cobra_total.basis: every public case of the one COBRA record

cobra_varian.basis: the Varian cases of the one COBRA record

coronary_angiography.basis: XCAD, CADICA, ARCADE and AngioCAD were never fetched and have no manifest record; the registry's link and steps are all there is

ctspinopelvic1k.basis: the Zenodo release, its build tree, the April release, and the TCIA collection its CTs come from

deepfluoro.basis: the H5 release, the vendor DICOMs and the Hugging Face re-host

dysphagiabank.basis: the UNM corpus clips are held in that record's folder dysphagiabank_unm (95 files on 2026-10-20); the TalkBank registration is the route to the rest

fluorogen_synth_rare.basis: synth_rare of that record: 12,929 renders, T13 86, L6 1,763, the registry's counts

jefferson_drg.basis: request 11; the registry says a CC BY copy of the video is usable, and the clip record does not list its PMC id, so that copy is unverified here

lumos.basis: the Zenodo record, planned and not fetched

mayfield_kyphoplasty.basis: request 6 for the DICOM series; the YouTube re-encode is among the 28 the clip record holds

neurosurgical_focus_video.basis: the journal's PMC videos are among the clips (FOCVID items in clips/ on 2026-10-20)

nhanes2_annotated.basis: the Zenodo landmarks over the CDC films

pediatric_iri.basis: IRI-VFI on IEEE DataPort was never fetched and has no manifest record; the registry's link and steps are all there is

procedure_guide.basis: request 9; the four clips the registry counts are YouTube re-encodes among the 28 the clip record holds

radiopaedia.basis: request 8 is the application text; nothing held, nothing scraped

seattle_science_foundation.basis: request 5 for the originals; the 12 YouTube videos are among the 28 the clip record holds

spinal_ai2024.basis: the release and its render-layout conversion

totalsegmentator.basis: both releases, their lateral DRRs, and the device corpus rendered from v3

verse.basis: the OSF release, the fused set, and the render banks made from it (ctsp_drr_obl is VerSe despite its name)

veterinary_pig_levelcheck.basis: the zips sit in spine-program's archive and the set is open on IEEE DataPort; no manifest record was ever made
